mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment favors risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5pp over three months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate a tight labor market and robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases over the past month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts and retail sales both exceed their three-month moving averages, it signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 3-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% over three months signals an industrial contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls by more than 1.0% over three months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.5%) supports a favorable monetary environment for equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the easing cycle continues.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (each exceeding 0.5% growth over the past month) signals strong consumer confidence and immediate economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise by more than 0.5% over the past month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
